verdict.rationale: Goodwin's employment practice page states that the firm develops and negotiates employment agreements and restrictive covenant agreements, which covers the core of the story as a documented practice. The Founders Workbench 'Hire' guide is named but its contents are not evidenced, and offer letters and invention-assignment/confidentiality agreements are never mentioned. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of offer-letter preparation, explicit invention-assignment/confidentiality (PIIA) agreement drafting, details of the Hire guide or templates, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm prepares hiring paperwork — offer letters, employment agreements, and invention-assignment/confidentiality agreements — as part of a documented employment practice

citations.quote: We develop and negotiate employment agreements, restrictive covenant agreements, compensation plans and employment separation agreements.
